concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-get-grant-offers-static-offers]] — 2026-09-15 pilot-qualified Capital static-offer list/detail/webhook guide for account-holder offers, seven-day validity and conditional renewal; examples have estimated/max-term and request/response-ID differences, and offers are not funded grants.
warnings: 90/180/360-day variable terms are labeled limited-availability pilot and require Adyen contact for access.
Specific-offer GET sample requests ID 0000000000000001 but response shows 0000000000000003; do not treat example as matched lookup.
Example repayment.term.estimatedDays and maximumDays differ; do not present estimated term as the contractual maximum.
